independent_T04_oracle.scope: Actual packet binary64 coordinates only; no kernel import/call
independent_T04_oracle.proof: Focal is x=z=0, y in[0,1]. Each target is the triangle [(x,0,0),(x,1,0),(x,0,1)], x>0. Constant x separation is a lower bound attained at y=z=0, so distance equals x exactly.

clocks.note: Nested observations; do not sum or subtract overhead as free work. Cold/warm timing does not establish model/task benefit.

native_close.scope: only launcher-owned Popen can attest wait/reap; reopened controller only requests closure

unknowns.note: The outer Popen PID differs from controller self PID; owner receipt attests only its Popen handle. Self PID is separately observed stopped. The unknown worker close-event is not rewritten by independent closed response/owner wait.

limits: Recorded-PID query cannot exclude PID reuse or unknown descendants. Terminal geometry/file checks cannot prove no reverted transient mutation or a Python sandbox.
